description: Gets one hotel's padel details: courts, indoor or outdoor, guest access, coaching, racket rental and season, how sure we are the court exists and when we last checked, plus its official website and booking links. Use it when someone asks about a specific hotel, or to follow up a search result.

hotel.description: The hotel's slug or url from search_padel_hotels, or its name.
